verdict.rationale: SerpApi is fundamentally an API-first product with extensive documented REST endpoints, JSON responses, markdown output optimized for LLMs/agents, official client SDKs (Python etc.), llms.txt and docs.md for AI consumption, and even an official MCP server. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found 404s on standard paths), and no independent hands-on report confirming full API completeness beyond docs.
